nodes.ua-creative-strategy.summary.en.text: I led Brand-side creative strategy for Genshin Impact's user acquisition, working with creators to make UA ads from scratch across Japan, North America and Europe. Brand creatives delivered ~3.7× projected LTV and 26% higher projected 365-day ROI than non-Brand ads.

site.intro.en.text:

translate performance data into creative insights that inform iterations and new concepts

nodes.ua-creative-strategy.results.1.en.text: Brand creative share of UA spend

nodes.ua-creative-strategy.sections.0.it.text: UA's own tests showed creator ads scaled and converted well, but its vendors, budget and team couldn't produce enough of them. Brand had creator resources but had never worked on UA. I had to build the pipeline from scratch and prove, within a few versions, that Brand creative could earn spend and bring quality players, not just add volume. The budget only covered smaller creators, so the content itself had to do the work.

nodes.ua-creative-strategy.sections.1.it.text: Built and owned the creative testing framework: turned UA's acquisition goals into market-specific creative hypotheses, tested across hooks, selling points, script structures and formats.
Directed creator production end to end: briefed creators, wrote mother scripts and gave feedback on every script and cut, so each video was made for UA from scratch.
Built an AI dashboard that tags creatives and surfaces winning patterns, speeding up analysis and iteration.

nodes.xbox-launch.summary.en.text: Structured a creative test for Genshin Impact's Xbox launch paid campaign to move console players from interest to landing-page action. Delivered 120M+ impressions, 52M+ video views, a 338% CTR lift versus the earlier benchmark.

nodes.xbox-launch.sections.0.items.0.en.text: The goal was to improve CTR and identify high-performing creatives. We had to turn existing brand materials into 100+ localized assets, our team’s largest creative test batch for a paid brand campaign. This required clear briefing and close coordination across languages, platform specs, and approvals.

nodes.xbox-launch.sections.1.items.0.en.text: Set the creative thesis: Used past campaign learnings and regional player insights to develop four testable creative concepts, adapting messaging for NA, FR, and DE audiences.

nodes.xbox-launch.sections.1.items.1.en.text: Coordinated creative production: Wrote detailed briefs covering copy, landing-page links, and platform specs for 144 localized assets, coordinating production timelines, reviews, and approvals.

nodes.xbox-launch.sections.1.items.2.en.text: Supported media planning and optimization: Helped shape budget allocation, regional priorities, and targeting across YouTube, Meta, X, and TikTok. Reviewed live performance with the media team to scale winning ads and pause underperformers.

nodes.xbox-launch.results.1.en.text: lower CPC versus the earlier benchmark

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.label.en.text: Zenless Zone Zero: JP Account Growth

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.summary.en.text: Scaled a Japanese UGC-style account network for Zenless Zone Zero to 80M+ organic views across 9 accounts, through targeted content strategies and repeatable growth system.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.sections.0.items.0.text: Following its launch, Zenless Zone Zero needed to build awareness and sustain player engagement in Japan through UGC-style accounts. Our team had little experience scaling these accounts in Japan, so I had to learn the market from scratch while testing what worked. Within a limited timeframe, I also needed to grow the network and establish a repeatable system that ZZZ team could take over.

nodes.ua-creative-strategy.team.en.text: Brand Creative Strategy (my role), UA Strategy x1, UA Execution x1, Agency Partners x4. UA owned media buying and budget; I owned the creative strategy and production.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.team.en.text: Social Strategy (my role), Japanese Content Review x2, Agency Partners x3

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.sections.1.items.0.text: Defined the social strategy: Researched Japanese player behavior, competitor accounts, and platform content gaps to shape account positioning and content pillars across YouTube and X.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.sections.1.items.1.text: Built testing framework: Used biweekly performance reviews to diagnose growth bottlenecks, test hypotheses, and refine hooks, angles, and formats. Turned winning approaches into repeatable content strategies.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.sections.1.items.2.text: Managed agency partnerships: Coordinated three agencies and local creators, aligning content briefs, reviews, and performance targets to improve content quality and cost efficiency.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.sections.1.items.a.text: Enabled team handover: Codified content learnings, KPIs, and operating routines into playbooks and SOPs, then supported the ZZZ brand team in taking over all nine accounts.

nodes.ua-creative-strategy.sections.1.it.text: Scaled what works, stopped what doesn't: reviewed every round with UA and turned performance data into the next hypotheses and briefs.
Codified what worked into regional playbooks and a repeatable Brand-to-UA workflow.
